```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load Required Libraries

```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(tictoc)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```

## Set Parameters

### Year to Load

```{r year to load}
year_to_load <- "2018"
```

### Parameters

```{r parameters}
# Parameters
sample_size <- 1 * 1e3
chunk_size <- 1e6

drop_cols <- 76:196 # Columns to drop (based on indexes)

to_read <- FALSE
to_sample <- TRUE
to_write <- TRUE
to_chunk <- FALSE
to_group <- TRUE
to_filter <- TRUE

na_values <- c('NONE', 'None', '-', '--', '---', 'N/A', 'n/a', 'nan', 'NAN')
na_like_strings <- c("", " ", "  ", "-", "none", "None", "NONE", "NA", "n/a", 
                     "N/A", "NaN", "'", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v", "\u00A0",
                     "\u2000", "\u2001", "\u2002", "\u2003", "\u2004", "\u2005", 
                     "\u2006", "\u2007", "\u2008", "\u2009", "\u200A", "\u2028", 
                     "\u2029", "\u202F", "\u205F", "\u3000")

# File paths
path_to_raw_claims <- "data-cleaning/raw_claims"
path_to_intermediate <- "data-cleaning/intermediate_claims"
path_to_cache <- "data-cleaning/cache"
path_to_aux <- "data-cleaning/aux_files"
path_to_excel <- "upload-libraries/Excel"
path_to_cleaned_claims <- "data-cleaning/cleaned_claims"
path_to_grouper_output <- "data-cleaning/grouper_output"

suffix <- ifelse(to_sample, "_sampled", "_full")
chunk_droppable_cols_file <- here(path_to_cache, paste0("chunk_droppable_cols_", year_to_load, suffix, ".rds"))
header_file <- here(path_to_cache, paste0("header_", year_to_load, suffix, ".rds"))
total_rows_file <- here(path_to_cache, paste0("total_rows_", year_to_load, suffix, ".rds"))
sampled_claims <- here(path_to_raw_claims, paste0("sampled_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv"))
full_claims <- here(path_to_raw_claims, paste0("claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv"))
intermediate_file <- here(path_to_intermediate, paste0("intermediate_claims_", year_to_load, "_processed.csv"))
cleaned_claims_file <- here(path_to_cleaned_claims, paste0("cleaned_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, suffix, ".csv"))
output_txt_file <- here(path_to_grouper_output, paste0("DRG_Grouped", suffix, "_", year_to_load, ".txt"))
grouper_result_file <- here(path_to_grouper_output, toupper(paste0("DRG_Grouped", suffix, "_", year_to_load, "Res.TXT")))

# Seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)
```

## Define Data Formats and Additional Parameters

```{r data formats and additional parameters}
source(here("data-cleaning", "drg-cleaning-data-formats.R"))
```

## Source Functions

```{r}
source(here("data-cleaning", "drg-cleaning-functions.R"))
```

## Load Mapping Data

```{r load mapping data}
proc <- read_csv(here(path_to_excel, "proc.csv")) %>%
  mutate(CODE = as.character(CODE))

rvs_icd9 <- read_csv(here(path_to_aux, "rvs_icd9cm.csv"), col_select = c("rvs", "icd9cm")) %>%
  mutate(rvs = as.character(rvs)) %>%
  mutate(icd9cm = as.character(icd9cm * 100)) %>%
  left_join(proc %>% select(CODE, DRGUSE), by = c("icd9cm" = "CODE")) %>%
  mutate(is_drg = !is.na(DRGUSE) & DRGUSE) %>%
  select(-DRGUSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rvs) & !is.na(icd9cm))

acr_rvs <- read_csv(here(path_to_aux, "acr_rvs.csv"))

# Read in the data.table
tdrg_icd10 <- fread(here(path_to_aux, "i10.csv"))

# Set the key if not already set
setkey(tdrg_icd10, "CODE")

# Subset and assign the result to acc_pdx
acc_pdx <- tdrg_icd10[ACCPDX == "Y", .(CODE)]

# Convert acc_pdx to a vector if needed
acc_pdx <- acc_pdx$CODE

# Optional: If you want to ensure uniqueness (if CODEs are not unique in tdrg_icd10)
acc_pdx <- unique(acc_pdx)
```

## Read Data

### Reading Data

```{r reading}
if (to_read) {
  df <- read_entire_file()
  
  if (to_sample) {
    if (file.exists(sampled_claims)) {
      df <- read_sampled_file()
      # Check if the number of rows matches sample_size
      if (nrow(df) != sample_size) {
        df <- read_entire_file()
        df <- sample_data(df)
        if (to_write) {
          write_data(df, sampled_claims)
        }
      }
    } else {
      df <- sample_data(df)
      if (to_write) {
        write_data(df, sampled_claims)
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  if (to_sample) {
    if (file.exists(sampled_claims)) {
      df <- read_sampled_file()
      # Check if the number of rows matches sample_size
      if (nrow(df) != sample_size) {
        df <- read_entire_file()
        df <- sample_data(df)
        if (to_write) {
          write_data(df, sampled_claims)
        }
      }
    } else {
      df <- read_entire_file()
      df <- sample_data(df)
      if (to_write) {
        write_data(df, sampled_claims)
      }
    }
  } else if (to_chunk) {
    if (!file.exists(chunk_droppable_cols_file) || !file.exists(header_file) || !file.exists(total_rows_file)) {
      process_chunks()
    } else {
      chunk_droppable_cols <- readRDS(chunk_droppable_cols_file)
      header <- readRDS(header_file)
      total_rows <- readRDS(total_rows_file)
    }
  } else {
    if (!file.exists(intermediate_file)) {
      stop("Cannot proceed: to_read is FALSE, to_sample is FALSE, and to_chunk is FALSE. At least one must be TRUE.")
    }
  }
}
```

### Identify Droppable Columns

```{r identify droppable columns}
if (to_read || (to_sample && !file.exists(sampled_claims))) {
  chunk_number <- 1
  chunk_droppable_cols <- list()
  header <- names(df)
  total_rows <- nrow(df)

  tic("Processing header row")
  cols_to_keep <- setdiff(seq_along(header), drop_cols)
  toc()

  tic("Identifying droppable columns")
  droppable_cols <- sapply(df, function(col) all(is.na(col) || col %in% na_like_strings))
  droppable_cols <- which(droppable_cols)
  chunk_droppable_cols[[paste0(year_to_load, "_whole")]] <- droppable_cols
  toc()

  saveRDS(chunk_droppable_cols, chunk_droppable_cols_file)
  saveRDS(header, header_file)
  saveRDS(total_rows, total_rows_file)
}
```

### Process Data in Chunks

```{r process data in chunks}
if (to_sample == FALSE && to_chunk == TRUE) {
  tic("Processing data in chunks")
  
  header <- fread(full_claims, nrows = 1, header = TRUE)
  total_rows <- fread(full_claims, select = 1L, header = TRUE)[, .N]
  cols_to_keep <- setdiff(seq_along(header), drop_cols)
  
  chunk_number <- 1
  repeat {
    skip_rows <- (chunk_number - 1) * chunk_size + 1
    if (skip_rows > total_rows) break
    
    droppable_cols <- process_chunk(chunk_number, skip_rows, cols_to_keep, total_rows, rvs_icd9)
    if (is.null(droppable_cols)) break
    
    chunk_number <- chunk_number + 1
  }
  
  toc()
}
```

### Merge Intermediate Files

```{r merge intermediate files}
if (to_sample == FALSE && to_chunk == TRUE && to_write == TRUE) {
  tic("Merging intermediate files")
  
  intermediate_files <- list.files(path_to_intermediate, pattern = "intermediate_chunk_.*\\.csv", full.names = TRUE)
  df_list <- lapply(intermediate_files, fread)
  df <- rbindlist(df_list)
  
  fwrite(df, intermediate_file)
  
  toc()
}
```

### Process Data if Not Chunking

```{r process data if not chunking}
if (to_chunk == FALSE && exists("df")) {
  df <- process_data(df, year_to_load, rvs_icd9)
  
  if (to_write) {
    fwrite(df, intermediate_file)
  }
}
```

    # Filter out rows where pdx is NA
    df <- df[!is.na(df$pdx), ]
  }
  export_for_batch_grouper(df, year_to_load, output_txt_file)
}

for_batch_grouping <- fread(output_txt_file, sep = "|", na.strings = "--")
